hints.title: Aggregate Sum Divisibility
hints.text: Each operation reduces an element by 1, which reduces the total array sum by 1.

hints.title: Nearest Multiple Downward
hints.text: The minimum number of unit decrements required to reach a multiple of k is the remainder of the total sum modulo k.

hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic Calculation
hints.text: Compute sum of nums modulo k directly.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass sum accumulation followed by modulo operation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterative subtraction simulation is unnecessarily slow when direct modular arithmetic solves it immediately.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that operations on individual elements translate directly to modular arithmetic on the total sum.
